ballpoint.moves: Draws itself line by line: contours, then hatching layer by layer.
ballpoint.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 15 ms a frame in a small test scene).
ballpoint.suits: Essays, explainers, technical notes, a notebook feel.
ballpoint.what: Ballpoint sketch: one blue pen on cream paper, tone only from where the hatching sits.

blueprint.moves: Ruled stroke by stroke, compass circles swung, lettering written.
blueprint.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 25 ms a frame in a small test scene).
blueprint.suits: Machines, engineering, how it's made, plans for a build.
blueprint.what: Cyanotype blueprint: ruling pen and compass in white ink on Prussian-blue stock.

brokenColour.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 21 ms a frame in a small test scene).
brokenColour.suits: Sunrise travel, mood, landscape, painting subjects.
brokenColour.what: Broken colour: plein-air dabs of unmixed oil on primed linen, side by side for the eye to mix, high key and full of light.

chalkboard.moves: Written stroke by stroke, tone drag by drag.
chalkboard.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 12 ms a frame in a small test scene).
chalkboard.suits: Lessons, teachers, classrooms, a worked step-by-step.
chalkboard.what: Chalkboard: chalk with its dust on a slate carrying the ghosts of old lessons.

charcoal.moves: Draws, rubs out and redraws on its own residue.
charcoal.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 20 ms a frame in a small test scene).
charcoal.suits: Change over time, memory, before and after.
charcoal.what: Charcoal, erased and redrawn: vine and compressed sticks, a stump and a kneaded eraser that never lifts it all.

colouredPencil.moves: Hatching builds strip by strip, pass by pass.
colouredPencil.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 16 ms a frame in a small test scene).
colouredPencil.suits: Workshops, how-it-works, children, school, family stories.
colouredPencil.what: Coloured pencil: wax pencils hatched in one diagonal on toothy cream paper, hues layered.

crayon.moves: Scribble fills arrive stroke by stroke.
crayon.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 26 ms a frame in a small test scene).
crayon.suits: Children, school, upbeat and handmade subjects.
crayon.what: Crayon: wax on toothy paper, back-and-forth scribble fills that skip the valleys, a darker crayon on the shade side, a white one burnishing the light, a fat wobbly contour gone over twice.

cutPaper.moves: Pieces are laid down one by one and can shift as flats.
cutPaper.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 13 ms a frame in a small test scene).
cutPaper.what: Cut-paper collage: torn and scissor-cut coloured papers on a backing board, not one drawn line, each piece lowered onto the stack with a shadow that pulls in.

dreamGlaze.moves: Glazes build up; forms hold still.
dreamGlaze.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 24 ms a frame in a small test scene).
dreamGlaze.what: Dream glaze: thin oil glazes with no visible stroke, every form turned by one low sun, every edge hard, an impossible picture painted as if it were real.

embroidery.moves: Stitched in, stitch by stitch; stitches can be re-posed in a loop.
embroidery.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 22 ms a frame in a small test scene).
embroidery.what: Hand embroidery: stranded cotton floss stitched through plain-weave linen in a beech hoop, every mark a length of twisted thread, made stitch by stitch with the needle in view.

flatVector.moves: Paths draw on; plates move under a camera.
flatVector.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 16 ms a frame in a small test scene).
flatVector.what: Flat vector: modern editorial illustration, crisp filled paths with no lines, atmospheric planes, long shadows and a grain brush on the shade side.

folkTale.moves: Painted from pencil to opaque; depth planes can move.
folkTale.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 19 ms a frame in a small test scene).
folkTale.suits: Fairy tales, family stories, long stories with a place.
folkTale.what: Folk-tale storybook: gouache over a pencil drawing, where depth is the medium: rich opaque paint up close thinning to a pale wash and then to bare pencil at the back.

halftone.moves: Prints on block by block; takes a real photo.
halftone.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 19 ms a frame in a small test scene).
halftone.what: Newsprint halftone: black on a 45-degree dot screen plus one spot colour, ink gaining into grey groundwood paper, a press coming up to colour.

inkWash.moves: Washes run down the shape, then the nib draws over them.
inkWash.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 19 ms a frame in a small test scene).
inkWash.suits: Field notes, nature journals, travel sketchbooks.
inkWash.what: Ink & line-wash: wet washes that settle and backrun, then a flexible nib over them.

isometric.moves: Built up piece by piece on the grid.
isometric.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 2 ms a frame in a small test scene).
isometric.suits: Software, systems, a place with rooms.
isometric.what: Isometric cutaway: flat vector planes on a true 2:1 grid, three tones per material, crisp edges, built up in a construction order.

lowPoly.moves: A 3D-looking mesh through a moving pinhole camera.
lowPoly.speed: too heavy to play smoothly live; exports normally (about 76 ms a frame in a small test scene).
lowPoly.what: Low-poly: triangle meshes projected by hand through a pinhole camera, each facet one flat colour from one low sun, sorted far to near, the triangulation the only texture.

markerComic.moves: Flats laid in chisel passes, then the contour grows.
markerComic.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 19 ms a frame in a small test scene).
markerComic.what: Marker comic: alcohol-marker cel fills laid in chisel passes, a hard shadow edge, and one heavy contour that thickens away from the light.

midCentury.moves: Flats go on, a dry brush drags, a loose line follows.
midCentury.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 19 ms a frame in a small test scene).
midCentury.suits: Travel posters, family stories, warm retro subjects.
midCentury.what: Mid-century gouache: opaque matte flats on warm board, a dry brush dragged across them and a loose ink line printed off register, like a 1950s picture book.

paintedOil.moves: Block-in to impasto, stroke by stroke.
paintedOil.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 24 ms a frame in a small test scene).
paintedOil.what: Oil on canvas: opaque paint with hog-bristle brushes on toned linen, lean block-in to fat impasto, painted dark to light in front of the viewer.

paperCraft.moves: Card flats moved by hand on twos, with shadows between them.
paperCraft.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 18 ms a frame in a small test scene).
paperCraft.suits: Stories behind a speaker, parallax scenes, teachers, families, children.
paperCraft.what: Toy-theatre paper collage: a cardboard stage, painted and printed flats with real gaps between them, moved by hand on twos.

pencilWatercolour.moves: Pencil lay-in, then washes spread from where the brush touched.
pencilWatercolour.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 20 ms a frame in a small test scene).
pencilWatercolour.suits: Gentle nature, recipes, a soft explainer, travel journals.
pencilWatercolour.what: Pencil & watercolour: graphite and pan washes on cold-press, paint that misses its outline.

pixelArt.moves: Cells laid one at a time; sprites can step on a grid.
pixelArt.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 19 ms a frame in a small test scene).
pixelArt.what: Pixel art: cells laid one at a time on a grid, each exactly one of sixteen palette colours, a staircase for an edge and a dither for a tone.

risograph.moves: Ink drums print one after another, off-register.
risograph.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 25 ms a frame in a small test scene).
risograph.what: Risograph: soy ink, one drum per colour, each ink multiplied through its own slightly wrong registration, tone made of halftone dots, white is bare paper.

rubberHose.moves: Boiling ink line, noodle limbs on a beat.
rubberHose.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 25 ms a frame in a small test scene).
rubberHose.what: Rubber hose: a 1930s studio cartoon, India ink at one pressure on a clear cel, flat greys on its back, noodle limbs, printed on black-and-white film.

scrapbook.moves: Cards laid, tape pulled, letters struck, under a slow camera.
scrapbook.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 26 ms a frame in a small test scene).
scrapbook.what: Archival scrapbook: a page from an old field album, with torn cards, tape, a typewriter, cut letters, a red pen and copperplate lines.

scratchboard.moves: Cut from black, flick by flick; long lines watched being cut.
scratchboard.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 14 ms a frame in a small test scene).
scratchboard.suits: Animals, night scenes, thrillers, old-book moods.
scratchboard.what: Scratchboard: every mark is ink scraped off a black board, white on black.

singleLine.moves: One line spirals out from the centre, racing through the lights.
singleLine.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 25 ms a frame in a small test scene).
singleLine.suits: One big image: a logo, a planet, a coin, a title.
singleLine.what: Single-line engraving: one unbroken line spiralling out, its width carrying the whole picture.

stipple.moves: Dots accumulate, dark masses first; nothing moves.
stipple.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 15 ms a frame in a small test scene).
stipple.suits: Science, anatomy, natural history, serious detail.
stipple.what: Pen-and-ink stipple: thousands of dots from one pen, tone only from how many.

storybook.moves: Pencil and washes on a page, with a recurring character that can walk.
storybook.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 22 ms a frame in a small test scene).
storybook.what: Storybook pencil and watercolour: soft graphite and gentle pan washes on warm cold-press paper, with a recurring character drawn in a picture-book illustrator's order.

sumiE.moves: A few strokes from wet to dry; the empty paper stays.
sumiE.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 22 ms a frame in a small test scene).
sumiE.what: Sumi-e: one loaded brush of black ink on absorbent paper, a few strokes that go from wet to dry-brush, mostly empty sheet, and a cinnabar seal.

toyBrick.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card (about 15 ms a frame in a small test scene).
toyBrick.what: Toy brick: moulded plastic bricks in an orthographic view, real proportions and studs, assembled step by step like an instruction booklet.

woodcut.moves: Keyblock and colour blocks print in turn; rain and water can run.
woodcut.speed: plays live on a PC with a graphics card, with hitches while its big marks go down (about 20 ms a frame in a small test scene).
woodcut.suits: Japan, history, travel, rain and water.
woodcut.what: Ukiyo-e woodblock: a carved black keyblock and flat colour blocks printed by hand onto soft washi, with the wood's grain in the colour and graded wipes in sky and water.
